meta.title: Cancer Help & Recovery
meta.scope_note: Nationwide guide plus one New England resource. Not every local program in all 50 states. Navigation, grants, coverage, wage replacement and donated services are labeled separately. A maximum award is a ceiling, not a promise. Program pages do not prove applications are open.
categories: For a specific cancer or age
Free advocate to help you apply

records.title: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)
records.summary: Monthly income when a qualifying impairment prevents substantial work.
records.eligibility_text: Requires enough recent covered work and SSA's disability standard: inability to perform substantial gainful work expected to last at least 12 consecutive months or result in death. A cancer diagnosis alone is insufficient. Retirement from work does not itself establish disability; ask SSA about the date last insured.
records.post_treatment_notes: Possible after successful cancer treatment when documented residual impairments still meet SSA's rules. No need to wait 12 months to apply if the duration requirement is expected to be met.
records.amount_text: Based on the worker's earnings record; generally a five-month waiting period.
records.application_instructions: Apply through SSA; 800-772-1213. Request an assessment of work credits, insured status and potential onset date.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
records.summary: Monthly means-tested cash assistance for basic needs.
records.eligibility_text: Low income and limited countable resources, plus qualifying disability/blindness or age 65+. No prior work record required. Ordinary countable-resource limits are $2,000 individual/$3,000 couple; exclusions and household rules apply.
records.post_treatment_notes: Possible after treatment if disability or age-based eligibility and financial criteria are met.
records.amount_text: Varies with countable income, living arrangements and possible state supplements.
records.application_instructions: Apply through SSA; 800-772-1213.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.age_notes: Age 65+, or qualifying disability/blindness at any age.

records.title: SSA Compassionate Allowances
records.summary: Faster disability claim identification and processing for listed serious conditions.
records.eligibility_text: Specific diagnoses/severity are required. The prostate entry is hormone-refractory disease or visceral metastases; it does not cover every prostate cancer diagnosis.
records.post_treatment_notes: Only if the exact qualifying condition applies; other disability evaluation remains available for lasting impairments.
records.amount_text: Not an additional grant or separate benefit, and not a universal waiver of payment waiting rules.
records.application_instructions: Tell SSA the exact diagnosis and provide pathology, staging and treatment records.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.eligibility_text: Coverage must apply under the actual policy; medical definition, coverage dates, exclusions, filing deadlines and offsets differ. Request the Summary Plan Description or policy from the plan administrator.

records.amount_text: Policy-specific; not the same program as SSDI.
records.application_instructions: Contact the insurer/benefits administrator. DOL EBSA assistance: 866-444-3272.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.post_treatment_notes: May cover a medically certified recovery period or qualifying caregiving leave.

records.title: VA disability compensation and cancer-related health benefits
records.organization: VA disability compensation and cancer-related health benefits
records.program_name: VA disability compensation and cancer-related health benefits
records.summary: Tax-free disability compensation and potentially VA health care for service-connected disease.
records.eligibility_text: Military service and connection/presumption requirements apply. Prostate cancer is on VA's Agent Orange presumptive list for qualifying exposure; PACT Act coverage depends on applicable service/exposure rules.
records.post_treatment_notes: Ask VA to assess ongoing residuals and current entitlement; a history of cancer does not by itself fix the payment level.
records.amount_text: Based on VA rating and circumstances.
records.application_instructions: VA: 800-698-2411; apply through VA or an accredited veterans representative.

records.title: FMLA leave and ADA workplace accommodations
records.organization: FMLA leave and ADA workplace accommodations
records.program_name: FMLA leave and ADA workplace accommodations
records.summary: Job protection, continued health coverage under qualifying FMLA leave, and reasonable workplace adjustments.
records.eligibility_text: Employee/employer eligibility and legal standards apply. FMLA generally provides up to 12 workweeks of unpaid protected leave; it is not a cash benefit. ADA accommodations depend on need and undue-hardship rules.
records.post_treatment_notes: Can remain relevant during remission and for lasting treatment limitations.
records.amount_text: Protection rather than a grant; paid leave may run alongside it.
records.application_instructions: Employer HR; DOL Wage and Hour Division: 866-487-9243. Triage Cancer can help explain options.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Hospital charity care / financial assistance policy
records.organization: Hospital charity care / financial assistance policy
records.program_name: Hospital charity care / financial assistance policy
records.summary: Free or discounted medically necessary hospital care and potential reduction of unpaid hospital debt.
records.eligibility_text: Tax-exempt hospitals must maintain written assistance policies. Income, household size and hardship criteria differ; having insurance does not automatically prevent help. Separate physician bills may not be covered.
records.post_treatment_notes: Yes: ask about outstanding bills even after treatment and, where relevant, bills in collections.
records.amount_text: May reduce or eliminate qualifying balances; no national dollar amount.
records.application_instructions: Ask the hospital billing office for its financial assistance application, plain-language policy and list of covered providers.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Dollar For
records.summary: Free help pursuing hospital financial assistance and bill forgiveness.
records.eligibility_text: Hospital bills only; its intake excludes standalone dental, ambulance, pharmacy and other non-hospital bills. Hospital policy determines financial eligibility.
records.post_treatment_notes: Yes: potentially useful for debt from completed treatment.
records.amount_text: No cash award; potential hospital-balance reduction.
records.application_instructions: Start through dollarfor.org/help or its official contact form.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Patient Advocate Foundation TotalAssist
records.summary: Disease-specific help with eligible out-of-pocket treatment costs, insurance premiums and other covered expenses.
records.eligibility_text: Match diagnosis, insurance, income and treatment requirements to the fund. Many funds use up to 500% FPL adjusted for local cost of living. General eligibility pages and fund-specific rules must be read together.
records.post_treatment_notes: Some funds include recent treatment and active surveillance; verify the particular fund instead of assuming all survivors qualify.
records.amount_text: Fund-specific; restricted expense coverage rather than unrestricted cash.
records.application_instructions: 866-512-3861; https://totalassist.org/funds/ . Sign up for fund-opening notices when closed.
records.application_status_notes: New/renewal PAN and PAF Co-Pay Relief assistance moved to TotalAssist July 1, 2026. Official indexed listings reviewed showed prostate, prostate health equity and metastatic prostate funds closed; recheck before applying.
records.research_status_text: New/renewal PAN and PAF Co-Pay Relief assistance moved to TotalAssist July 1, 2026. Official indexed listings reviewed showed prostate, prostate health equity and metastatic prostate funds closed; recheck before applying.

records.title: HealthWell Foundation
records.summary: Disease-specific medication copay/premium assistance and certain other costs.
records.eligibility_text: Insured patients whose medication and diagnosis meet fund rules; income limits vary by fund, commonly 300%-500% FPL. Treatment must be in the United States.
records.post_treatment_notes: Only if there is an eligible ongoing expense and covered diagnosis/treatment; not general recovery income.
records.amount_text: Fund-specific. Prostate Cancer Medicare Access lists a $6,000 maximum, not a guaranteed payment.
records.application_instructions: 800-675-8416; use the fund list and alerts.
records.application_status_notes: Prostate Cancer Medicare Access fund: closed to new patients (rechecked Nov. 10, 2026: "temporarily closed to new patients due to lack of sufficient funding"). Other funds have their own status.
records.research_status_text: Prostate Cancer Medicare Access directly reviewed: closed to new patients. Other funds have separate status.

records.title: CancerCare Co-Payment Assistance Foundation
records.summary: Help with eligible medication copays, coinsurance and deductibles.
records.eligibility_text: Insured patients with a covered cancer/medication and qualifying income, generally up to 500% FPL; some funds restrict insurance types. This program does not cover general scans, radiation, lab bills or premiums.
records.post_treatment_notes: Usually tied to covered active treatment or a treatment plan rather than a cancer history alone.
records.amount_text: Varies by diagnosis; some qualifying first-time applicants may receive eligible reimbursement up to 60 days before approval.
records.application_instructions: 866-552-6729; select the diagnosis on the official fund page.
records.application_status_notes: Fund openings change. Closed funds offer reopening email notifications, not a waiting list.
records.research_status_text: Fund openings change. Closed funds offer reopening email notifications, not a waiting list.

records.title: The Assistance Fund (TAF)
records.summary: Disease-specific prescription copay help and, for certain programs, additional treatment expenses.
records.eligibility_text: Application requires diagnosis, income/household and insurance information. Covered expenses and criteria depend on the disease program.
records.post_treatment_notes: Ask whether current expenses and treatment meet the disease-program rules.
records.amount_text: Varies by program; assistance operates on a calendar-year basis.
records.application_instructions: Use TAF's online disease program and enrollment portal.
records.application_status_notes: Program-specific availability; most closed programs offer a time-stamped waitlist. Reenrollment occurs in November/December.
records.research_status_text: Program-specific availability; most closed programs offer a time-stamped waitlist. Reenrollment occurs in November/December.

records.title: Good Days
records.summary: Copayment assistance for covered disease treatments.
records.eligibility_text: Generally income at or below 500% FPL, insurance covering at least 50% of treatment, valid Social Security number, U.S. treatment and an eligible FDA-approved medicine. Fund must accept enrollment.
records.post_treatment_notes: Only when ongoing covered treatment/expenses meet criteria.
records.amount_text: Fund-specific; calendar-year award or until funds exhausted.
records.application_instructions: 877-968-7233; review covered diseases and apply.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Drug manufacturer patient assistance programs
records.summary: Free medication or financial assistance for eligible people who cannot afford a prescribed drug.
records.eligibility_text: Manufacturer-, drug-, income- and coverage-specific. Free-drug programs and commercial insurance copay cards are different; Medicare eligibility must be assessed under the particular program.
records.post_treatment_notes: Potentially, if an eligible medicine is still needed for cancer or related illness.
records.amount_text: Drug-specific; may supply medicine instead of money.
records.application_instructions: Ask the oncology pharmacist to check the manufacturer's current patient assistance program; CMS explains how free-drug PAPs can operate for Part D enrollees.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.eligibility_text: State residency and state/category-specific income, age, pregnancy or disability criteria. Applications can be made year-round.
records.post_treatment_notes: Yes if financial/categorical eligibility is met; active cancer is not required.
records.amount_text: Health coverage rather than a general cash grant.
records.application_instructions: Apply to your state Medicaid agency or through the Marketplace screening route.
records.application_status_notes: Applications accepted year-round per the official source.

records.title: CancerCare financial assistance
records.summary: Limited grants for specified costs such as transportation, home care, childcare and other funded needs.
records.eligibility_text: Cancer confirmation, active treatment, U.S./Puerto Rico residence and financial criteria. Available aid is diagnosis- and location-dependent; home/childcare help should not be assumed nationwide.
records.post_treatment_notes: General grant program is principally active-treatment based; ask a social worker about exact current criteria.
records.amount_text: No universal award amount published on the reviewed general page.
records.application_instructions: 800-813-4673; social-worker screening starts the application.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.title: Cancer Cartel Warrior grant
records.summary: One-time unrestricted assistance with everyday expenses.
records.eligibility_text: Current treatment or within 12 months of completion. Only an approved hospital/cancer-center social worker, case manager or navigator can submit; medical documentation required.
records.post_treatment_notes: Yes, but within the 12-month treatment-completion window and subject to the rules when applications reopen.
records.amount_text: $1,000 one-time grant.
records.application_instructions: Ask the oncology social-work team to review the current portal and submit when available.
records.application_status_notes: Rechecked Nov. 10, 2026: portal closed. Next opening projected Feb. 1, 2027, 9 a.m. Pacific (projected, not guaranteed).
records.research_status_text: Portal closed on review. Next opening projected February 1, 2027, 9 a.m. Pacific; projected, not guaranteed. The grant-information page supersedes older October-opening wording.

records.title: Family Reach
records.summary: Grants for non-medical needs such as housing, utilities, groceries and transportation.
records.eligibility_text: Active treatment in the U.S./territories, generally household income within 300% FPL, and an available matching fund. Healthcare-team member must apply. Its administrative active-treatment definition excludes long-term hormonal therapy and certain other categories; this is an eligibility rule, not a medical definition.
records.post_treatment_notes: Generally not a broad post-treatment grant.
records.amount_text: Fund-specific; bills may be paid to vendors.
records.application_instructions: 973-394-1411; ask the treatment team to review and apply through the official financial-assistance page.
records.application_status_notes: Rechecked Nov. 10, 2026: the only grant funds listed are for multiple myeloma (active treatment or specified clinical trials). No open all-cancer household grant.
records.research_status_text: Reviewed page listed multiple-myeloma and specified clinical-trial funds. Do not advertise general grants as open for every cancer.

records.title: SAMFund financial assistance
records.summary: Support for eligible young adult survivors' housing, vehicle payments, continuing education and specified cancer-related needs.
records.eligibility_text: U.S. residents ages 21-39, not tax dependents, with defined remission/stable-disease criteria and prior-award limits. Active chemotherapy/radiation is ineligible. Review exclusions; it is not a general medical-debt or utility grant.
records.post_treatment_notes: Designed for survivorship.
records.amount_text: Award amount not fixed on reviewed page.
records.application_instructions: 617-938-3484; use Expect Miracles Foundation's grant page and prepare the required medical/tax documentation.
records.application_status_notes: Rechecked Nov. 10, 2026: closed; spring cycle opens January 2027.
records.research_status_text: Closed on direct review; spring cycle announced to open January 2027.

records.title: Joe Andruzzi Foundation — regional exception relevant to Rhode Island
records.summary: Household bills, grocery cards, selected extraordinary needs and treatment transportation.
records.eligibility_text: New England residents in active treatment for household/food assistance; medical-team application required. Transportation program is Massachusetts/Rhode Island only.
records.post_treatment_notes: Core programs focus on active treatment; confirm any exceptional circumstances.
records.amount_text: Household grants up to $800; grocery cards $150 for one person, $250 for 2-4, $300 for 5+; extraordinary-needs grants up to $4,000.
records.application_instructions: Oncology social worker/navigator applies. Rides: ttp@joeandruzzifoundation.org; grants: grants@joeandruzzifoundation.org.
records.application_status_notes: Rechecked Nov. 10, 2026: household, grocery, extraordinary-needs and MA/RI ride programs all listed, with no closure notice. Regional, New England only.
records.research_status_text: Regional, not nationwide. Grant amounts are maximums or household-based amounts, not automatic entitlement.

records.title: Pink Fund
records.summary: Up to 90 days of non-medical living-expense assistance for breast cancer.
records.eligibility_text: Active treatment as Pink Fund defines it; patient or spouse/partner working at diagnosis with lost work income; household income within 300% FPL; diagnosis within two years. Long-term hormonal therapy/reconstruction alone do not qualify as active treatment.
records.post_treatment_notes: Usually no once qualifying active treatment has ended.
records.amount_text: Up to 90 days of approved expenses; not a universal monthly check.
records.application_instructions: Complete the Pink Fund online prequalification and application.
records.application_status_notes: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.
records.research_status_text: Program described on official website; individual eligibility and capacity not confirmed.

records.post_treatment_notes: Explicitly may include remission with post-treatment complications and continuing medical care.
records.amount_text: Committee-determined; pays creditors directly, not reimbursements or cash to patients. May reapply after 12 months.
records.application_instructions: 203-714-6052; download the application and current program guide.

records.amount_text: Most grants described as averaging $1,000-$1,500; exact amount and type vary.
